drupal/canvas.description: Fix TypeError in ComponentMetadataRequirementsChecker closure when example items are not arrays/objects

drupal/drupal_cms_helper.description: form_user_register_form_alter sets the admin-only notify checkbox's #default_value to TRUE unconditionally; on anonymous self-registration that element is #access FALSE, so Form API resolves it to the default and RegisterForm::save() treats every self-registration as admin-created — wrong welcome email (an unusable one-time login link on a blocked pending-approval account) and no pending-approval notification to the admin. Scope the whole alter to the admin-create form

drupal/mercury.description: Preserve custom component prop schema (overlay_opacity on cta; relax overly strict uri-reference format on url/href/cite_url/button_url props that breaks the site-wide 'No URL' sentinel convention and causes Canvas component-version hash drift/OutOfRangeException)

drupal/bee.description: AddReservationForm empties an existing cart on every new reservation submission, so a customer can never have more than one booking in a cart at a time — stop that, let bookings accumulate like a normal cart (needed for the shh multi-facility package discount)

Attach bat_fullcalendar's standard library instead of the -scheduler variant for hourly types (public node view, staff availability screen, availability form): the scheduler JS hardcodes premium resourceTimeline* toolbar buttons with no schedulerLicenseKey — unlicensed FullCalendar Premium views reachable from every calendar — while every configured view on this platform is the standard dayGridMonth. The standard variant also drops the extra units REST fetch (task 0009)

Node edit form alter hardcodes field_price_frequency #default_value to 'hour', silently reverting a 'minute'-priced facility on every staff form save (bee's own hour pricing then computes 0.00 for sub-hour bookings); the branch only runs on edit forms where the widget already has the stored value, so drop the override (task 0043)

drupal/bat_api.description: EventsRestResource::get() references $this->eventType, which is never assigned on the class, so bat_api/rest/calendar-events (hit by the FullCalendar widget embedded on every BEE-bookable node view) always fatals with 'Call to a member function usesStates() on null' — use the local $bat_event_type already loaded a few lines above instead, exactly like the rest of the method does

drupal/bat.description: bat_fullcalendar loads FullCalendar from the jsdelivr CDN at runtime (standard bundle UNPINNED = whatever version jsdelivr serves that day) — point the bat-fullcalendar-cdn library at the locally vendored copy in /libraries/fullcalendar instead (vendored via the fullcalendar/fullcalendar composer repository entry, matching the Webform JS-dependency pattern; task 0009)

drupal/geofield.description: Convert geofield plugins to PHP attributes for Drupal 11
Update geofield validation constraint metadata for Drupal 11
